about: Renew a citizen's passport that has expired or has a year or less left.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: UAE citizens living in the UAE; citizens abroad use the separate abroad service
Passport expired or valid for one year or less
Fingerprints and signature at a service centre if required
documents: Recent personal photo different from the one in the current passport, meeting ICAO standards
timing: Valid 10 years at 21 or over, 5 years under 21
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
